protocol: Mayo Rochester indoctrination of 21 visiting crews. Forty-four chamber runs at 35,000 ft or higher. People could attend multiple runs. Run duration, altitude trajectory, oxygen equipment and denitrogenation differ.
outcome_window: During the logged training series. The ascertainment of delayed symptoms and a common follow-up interval are unavailable.
locator: Series A No. 2, Factual Data B.1–4, NLM image 48. Progress Report No. 6, Part III, vol. 2, NLM image 38.
note: The authors give 23 affected men among 203 people. The 380 figure counts man-flights, including repeated attendance. The endpoint is source-reported incapacitation from bends and omits symptoms without incapacity.
